branch_activations.independent_trigger: The interpretation noun names the directed domain.
branch_activations.activation: Teaching and an interpreted domain meet to make the capacity acquired intelligibility.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Joseph learns a directed interpretive capacity.
branch_activations.boundary: The associated teaching facet is attributed; it does not equate Joseph's knowledge with divine comprehensiveness.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin geri dönmesi veya sonunda belirli bir duruma varmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: Ta'wil carries return and arrival at a result.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Al-ahadith supplies reports and events that require interpretation.
branch_activations.activation: A report/event object gives the return carrier a concrete interpretive field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Interpretation returns reports and events toward their realized outcomes.
branch_activations.boundary: The core return facet is retained; no single outcome or method is imposed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yokken var olma, var etme veya gerçekleşme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey, daha önce yokken varlık kazanır.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-ahadith carries newly occurring things within its event-capable root field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Ta'wil supplies the interpretive operation applied to the object.
branch_activations.activation: The interpretive operation gives the event facet a direction toward meaning and result.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Newly occurring events remain inside the taught object-domain.
branch_activations.boundary: The event facet is attributed and does not narrow al-ahadith to events alone.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye işitme veya bildirim yoluyla ulaşan söz ve aktarılan içeriktir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-ahadith carries heard speech and transmitted content.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Ta'wil supplies the operation of returning content toward its sense and outcome.
branch_activations.activation: The report facet meets the interpretive noun, keeping utterance and narrative within the field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Joseph's taught interpretation includes reports and narratives as well as events.
branch_activations.boundary: The report facet is attributed and does not claim every utterance is revelatory.

findings.title: b_family_return_field
findings.claim: The attributed HFT trace changes the local reading to: Joseph's return-reading is embedded in a household of reciprocal return, so the gift is answerable to a lineage and not complete as private expertise.
findings.mechanism: The same focus root carries outcome-return and the household as those who return to one another; this couples the epistemic gift to a reciprocal lineage rather than leaving interpretation as an individual possession.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the supplied local change without losing the ordinary focus reading.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as legacy-unbound attributed evidence; it does not establish an independent lexicon verdict or a wider claim beyond the focus ayah.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor and trace are supplied, but the packet qualifies the HFT identity and branch application as attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin geri dönmesi veya sonunda belirli bir duruma varmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: Ta'wil carries return toward a result or origin.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Al names the household recipient field that follows.
branch_activations.activation: The lineage recipient gives the return carrier a relational setting rather than a private one.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Joseph's interpretive gift is heard within a household field.
branch_activations.boundary: The return facet remains attributed and does not alter al's immediate household sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin ev halkını, ailesini, yakınlarını ve bakmakla yükümlü olduğu kimseleri kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: Al carries an attached household and lineage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Ta'wil supplies the neighboring return-to-origin operation.
branch_activations.activation: Household belonging meets interpretive return, making the gift relational and genealogical.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Interpretation is not complete as isolated private expertise.
branch_activations.boundary: The household facet is attributed and does not universalize the lineage.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: babalık, besleyip yetiştirme ve oluşuma ya da iyileşmeye kaynaklık etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimsenin baba olması, babalık ilişkisi taşıması veya baba soyunu temsil etmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The paternal dual carries fatherhood and formative ancestry.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named Lord-title at the coda returns the relation to a governing personal source.
branch_activations.activation: Fatherhood and the named Lord relation connect favor to a formative lineage.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promised benefit is heard as extending through a father-to-son line.
branch_activations.boundary: The core fatherhood facet is attributed; no extra genealogy is added.

findings.title: b_knowing_wisdom_governance
findings.claim: The attributed HFT trace changes the local reading to: Knowing names full disclosure of the pattern, while Wise names the restraining and ordering governance that lets the promise reach completion.
findings.mechanism: Knowledge discloses the pattern, while wisdom prevents corruption for repair and brings a matter into firm order; the closing titles state how the promised process can be governed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the supplied local change without losing the ordinary focus reading.
findings.containment: The trace is retained as legacy-unbound attributed evidence; it does not establish an independent lexicon verdict or a wider claim beyond the focus ayah.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor and trace are supplied, but the packet qualifies the HFT identity and branch application as attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The final alim carries comprehensive knowing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier teaching form supplies the pattern being disclosed.
branch_activations.activation: Divine knowing meets the teaching act and names the source capable of disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promised teaching is grounded in comprehensive divine knowledge.
branch_activations.boundary: The core knowing facet is attributed and does not grant Joseph the same scope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, birini istediği veya yöneldiği şeyden ya da bir şeyi bozulmadan alıkoyup geri çevirmektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hakim carries restraining a harmful course and turning it back.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Alim supplies the knowing predicate that identifies the pattern requiring governance.
branch_activations.activation: Knowing and restraint meet in the coda's characterization of the Lord.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Wisdom is heard as an active check against corrupting force.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed branch colors wisdom; it does not reduce hakim to mere prohibition.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin yapısı veya düzeni sağlamlaştırılır ve kusur barındırmayacak biçimde tamamlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: Hakim carries making a structure sound and ordered.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The completion verb supplies the process whose coherence needs ordering.
branch_activations.activation: Wise ordering meets active completion, making the promise's process hold together.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The coda presents completion as wisely ordered rather than merely finished.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordering facet is attributed and does not claim no other wisdom facet can coexist.

friction_notes: Focus-word alignment is complete at 32 of 32 words, but the packet supplies no connection records or selected non-focus units; no connection-based activation is added.

The five HFT traces are retained as qualified attributed evidence: exact Arabic verifies surface contact, while their word indices, roots, roles, and before/after changes remain attributed rather than independent lexicon proof.

Wider ayat named inside word-analysis support are not treated as independently projected micro context; narrowed decisions retain the focus-local core and explicitly record the excluded context references.
